analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The head diff touches line 564 (the benchmark flag table, adding `--runtime-concurrency <sizes>` and `--runtime-stagger`) and lines 1208-1209 (the `--kv-quantization` and `--kv-checkpoint-quantization` benchmark option rows). The supplied base units cover lines 831-1806, so they include the base side of the 1208-1209 region. The line 564 change and the head text of 1208-1209 appear only in the patch excerpt, which is truncated. Nothing is added that touches security-sensitive behavior. The text describes local benchmark diagnostics that use production CBv2 slots with prefix caches off. It adds no new endpoint, key handling, attestation or authorization path, and it does not change the coordinator-provider trust boundary. T-041 (prefix-cache storage, TTL, HMAC naming) is not affected, because the benchmark docs say that caches stay off in these runs and that they do not prove checkpoint compression. The base text around the changed rows contains no instructions or claims that weaken the threat model. The security controls described in the surrounding unchanged text (drain lifecycle, logout and unenroll, fan helper, report upload redaction, environment passthrough) are not modified here. Remaining gap: the documented `--runtime-concurrency` and `--runtime-stagger` flags refer to a `RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark` implementation that is not in the supplied evidence. I cannot confirm that code does not touch prompts, logs or reports. Because this is a documentation-only change, I treat this as an unverified contract and not as a finding. No findings.
